Sooners Minnesota Golden Gophers West Virginia Mountaineers Creighton Bluejays Baylor Bears Colorado Buffaloes Stanford Cardinal About The College Basketball Crown The 2026 College Basketball Crown is an eight-team, single-elimination men’s postseason tournament held in Las Vegas from April 1–5, showcasing top NCAA Division I programs. Games will air on FOX and FS1, with streaming available across Fox Sports platforms and Fox One. Matchups will be played at the MGM Grand Garden Arena and T-Mobile Arena. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONSWhen is the 2026 College Basketball Crown? The College Basketball Crown will be held from April 1 - April 5Where will the College Basketball Crown take place? The College Basketball Crown will take place in Las Vegas and be played at the MGM Grand Garden Arena and T-Mobile Arena. How can I watch the College Basketball Crown?You can watch the tournament on FS1 and Fox. Games will be available to watch on Fox Sports platforms and be streamed on FOX One. What is different about this year's tournament? This year's tournament will feature 8 teams in a quarterfinals format. The championship game will take place on Sunday April 5th on Fox at 5:30pm ET/2:30pm PT. When will the College Basketball Crown teams be announced?Teams will be announced on Monday March 16, 2026.
